name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The environment says the goal must follow opening the door with the key, but the clauses do not order `door_open` before `at_goal`. `Precedence(door_open, key_lost)` only orders key loss. Add hard `Precedence(door_open, at_goal)`; with the existing hard `Existence(at_goal)`, it also requires the door to have been opened.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(door_open, key_lost) forbids losing the key before the door has first opened, and Existence(at_goal) requires reaching the goal.

texts: Do not lose the key before the door has been opened once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&!door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, !at_goal&door_open) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&!key_lost) -> u3
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&door_open) -> u3
(u2, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
